title: Decoding the functional code of Tuo tea: From untargeted metabolomic profiling to multi-target anti-diabetic mechanisms via liver-pancreas metabolic crosstalk.
authors: Yue, Rongbosen; Zhao, Zhiyuan; Liu, Xijia; Luo, Liyong; Liu, Yan; Zeng, Liang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究沱茶抗糖尿病机制，涉及代谢组学、网络药理学和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a growing global health challenge marked by insulin resistance and limited therapeutic options. Tuo tea (CT), a fermented dark tea from Southwest China with reputed hypoglycemic benefits, has unclear bioactive components and mechanisms. Here, we investigated the effects of Tuo tea on insulin resistance using a high-fat/high-sucrose and streptozotocin-induced T2DM mouse model, and explored its multi-organ mechanisms through an integrated strategy combining untargeted metabolomics, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and cellular validation. Tuo tea intervention significantly ameliorated hyperglycemia, insulin resistance, and dyslipidemia, while concurrently alleviating hepatic steatosis and pancreatic islet damage. Integrated analysis identified 548 bioactive constituents and pinpointed FXR, KEAP1, and NF-kappaB as pivotal targets. Molecular docking prioritized 1,2,6-tri-O-galloyl-beta-d-glucopyranose (1,2,6-TGGP) as a key phytopharmacological molecule, which was further validated to enhance glucose metabolism and boost antioxidant capacity in insulin-resistant HepG2 cells, acting through modulation of the FXR/SHP, KEAP1/Nrf2, and NF-kappaB pathways. These findings demonstrate that Tuo tea alleviates insulin resistance by orchestrating liver-pancreas crosstalk via multi-target mechanisms that mitigate oxidative stress and inflammation, with 1,2,6-TGGP identified as a highly active compound. This study establishes a systematic pharmacological foundation for Tuo tea as a dietary intervention strategy for T2DM.
abstract_zh: 2型糖尿病（T2DM）是一种日益严峻的全球健康挑战，其特征为胰岛素抵抗及治疗选择有限。沱茶（Tuo tea）是一种源自中国西南地区的发酵黑茶，据称具有降血糖功效，但其生物活性成分和作用机制尚不明确。本研究采用高脂/高蔗糖联合链脲佐菌素诱导的T2DM小鼠模型，考察了沱茶对胰岛素抵抗的影响，并通过整合非靶向代谢组学、网络药理学、分子对接和细胞验证的策略，探索了其多器官作用机制。沱茶干预显著改善了高血糖、胰岛素抵抗和血脂异常，同时减轻了肝脂肪变性和胰岛损伤。整合分析鉴定出548种生物活性成分，并确定FXR、KEAP1和NF-kappaB为关键靶点。分子对接将1,2,6-三-O-没食子酰基-β-D-吡喃葡萄糖（1,2,6-TGGP）列为关键植物药理分子，进一步验证表明其通过调节FXR/SHP、KEAP1/Nrf2和NF-kappaB通路，增强胰岛素抵抗HepG2细胞的葡萄糖代谢并提升抗氧化能力。这些发现表明，沱茶通过多靶点机制协调肝-胰串扰，减轻氧化应激和炎症，从而缓解胰岛素抵抗，其中1,2,6-TGGP被鉴定为高活性化合物。本研究为沱茶作为T2DM膳食干预策略建立了系统的药理学基础。
